name: Mapper Foundations
description: Manual field mappings, typed constants, functions, target schema, Map & Test, logging, and task output.

name: Transformation Regression
description: Named lookups, saved transformation suites, bounded execution and both Python archive formats.

name: XML and JSON Mediation
description: Parse an XML order, map its fields, and render a JSON response.

name: REST Service Mediation
description: Continuous REST receiver, request mapping, structured logging, and HTTP response.

name: JDBC Prepared Query
description: Typed named SQL parameters, result publication, logging, and environment-driven database connection.

name: Event Messaging Patterns
description: Separate EMS, Kafka, and Pub/Sub starter tasks with automatic continuous receiving and acknowledgement patterns.

name: Scheduled Integration
description: A scheduler starter that runs immediately in local Run/Debug, writes structured logs, and returns execution metadata.

name: CSV to XML Mediation
description: Parse typed CSV records into the XML output contract, log the record count, and publish the result.

name: Transform Order Collection
description: Use the executable DataWeave-compatible Transform language to normalize and enrich an order collection.

name: Reusable Sub Task Composition
description: Map input into a reusable Sub Task, execute it synchronously, and return the child task output to the caller.

name: Variables and Process Context
description: Assign a process variable, update process context, create a checkpoint, and inspect structured execution output.

name: Excel Multi-sheet Reader
description: Read every worksheet from an Excel workbook and publish nested JSON keyed by worksheet name.

name: Outbound REST Client
description: Invoke an environment-configured HTTP API, map its response, and retain request/response diagnostics.

name: AMQP Reliable Consumer
description: Continuously receive from an AMQP queue, log the message, and confirm successful processing.

name: Snowflake Analytics Query
description: Run a parameterized Snowflake query through a shared connection and publish the selected rows.

name: SAP IDoc Inbound Mediation
description: Receive an ARTMAS05 IDoc, log the canonical XML, parse its fetched SAP fields into complete JSON, log the JSON, and publish it to a EMS queue.
